uzo.purpose: Lets a person write Markdown and see it as it will be shown: the source and its preview side by side, the preview following every input.

instead.kialo: Content that is only shown is a markdovido, because there is nothing to write.

boundary.kialo: Formatting by buttons over the text is not supported, because the source stays the text a person reads and writes; the preview shows the result.

containers.name: page
containers.kialo: An editor stands in a formularo or a section of a pagxo, because it is part of the task the page is about.

with.kialo: The source is a tekstareo of kind code, because Markdown is text in the code role.
The preview is a markdovido, because it shows the source as the page will.
